    StartersMandrake Falls garlic parmesan knotsPizza dough knots brushed with garlic butter and parmesan, marinaraHow to make it500g pizza dough60g butter3 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp chopped parsley40g parmesan, finely grated300ml marinara sauceCut the dough into strips, roll each into a rope and tie into a knot.Lay on a lined tray and rest.Bake at 220°C until golden.Melt the butter with the garlic and parsley, brush over the hot knots and scatter with parmesan.Warm the marinara and serve for dipping.Hallmark card cheese and tomato pinwheelsPuff pastry spirals with sundried tomato pesto, ham, basil and cheeseHow to make it2 sheets of puff pastry, thawed4 tbsp sundried tomato pesto8 slices of leg ham1 small bunch basil120g tasty cheese, grated1 egg, beatenLay the pastry flat and spread with the pesto. Top with ham, basil and cheese.Roll up tightly and chill.Cut each roll into slices and lay cut-side down on a lined tray. Brush with egg.Bake at 200°C until puffed and golden.Meatball sliders with melted provolonePam Dawson from Winchestertonfieldville, Iowa, orders two.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsMandrake Falls pepperoni mushroom pizzaPepperoni, garlic mushroom and mozzarella pizza with chilli oilHow to make it750g pizza dough200ml pizza sauce200g mushrooms, sliced1 garlic clove, crushed2 tbsp olive oil300g mozzarella, grated120g sliced pepperoni1 tsp dried oregano1 tbsp chilli oil, to drizzleDivide the dough in two and stretch each into a round on oiled trays. Spread with pizza sauce.Fry the mushrooms with the garlic in a little oil.Top the bases with mozzarella, pepperoni and mushrooms.Bake at 240°C until blistered.Scatter with oregano and drizzle with chilli oil.Emilio's very, very sneaky baked zitiEmilio, the butler who is very, very sneakyHow to make it400g ziti or penne400g Italian pork sausages, skins off1 onion, diced2 garlic cloves, crushed700g tomato passata250g ricotta250g mozzarella, grated40g parmesan, grated100g rocket2 tbsp olive oilHeat the oven to 200°C. Boil the pasta until just short of done and drain.Brown the sausage in the oil, add the onion and garlic, then the passata, and simmer.Toss the pasta with the sauce, layer into a dish with spoonfuls of ricotta and top with mozzarella and parmesan.Bake until bubbling and blistered. Serve with rocket dressed with oil.SweetsNew York baked cheesecake with berriesBaked cheesecake on a biscuit base with warm berry sauceHow to make it200g plain sweet biscuits80g butter, melted500g cream cheese, soft200g caster sugar3 eggs150g sour cream1 lemon, juiced1 tsp vanilla extract300g frozen mixed berriesCrush the biscuits, mix with the butter and press into a lined 20cm springform tin. Chill.Beat the cream cheese with most of the sugar, then the eggs, sour cream, lemon juice and vanilla.Pour over the base and bake at 150°C until just set.Cool in the oven with the door ajar.Chill until firm.Simmer the berries with the remaining sugar and spoon over.DrinksCola float with whipped creamCola poured over vanilla ice cream, whipped cream and a cherryHow to make it8 scoops of vanilla ice cream1.3 L cold cola100ml thickened cream, whipped4 cocktail cherriesChill tall glasses in the freezer.Add ice cream to each glass.Slowly pour cola down the side until it foams to the top, letting it settle and topping up.Finish with whipped cream and a cherry. Serve with straws and long spoons.Pink lemonade with fresh mintVery, very sneaky, says Emilio.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
